evidence:
Source agreement, assumption by assumption (test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template).

1. Entry file: test.sh:68 `if [[ ! -f /app/server.js ]]` and test.sh:111 `node "$APP_ENTRY"`. Told: instruction.md:15 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5 'The process starts from /app/server.js'.
2. Port: test.sh:108 `PORT="3000"`, probes at test.sh:48 on 127.0.0.1:3000, prompts open http://localhost:3000. Told: instruction.md:15 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5-6 'listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0'.
3. Liveness path: test.sh:48 probes `/api/health` then `/`, any HTTP status counts. Told: instruction.md:15 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:9-10 'GET /api/health answers before database work can block startup'.
4. Database: test.sh:98,109 `DB_PATH="$APP_DB"` (/app/app.db, or /tmp/submission/app.db in the fallback); the restart helper reuses the same value (test.sh:165). Told: instruction.md:15 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-9; hireops_rules.md:420.
5. Injected environment: test.sh:104-109 `env -i` with PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH only. Told: hireops_rules.md:420-422 'The launch environment contains `PATH`, `HOME`, `NODE_PATH`, `PORT` and `DB_PATH`; do not rely on inherited shell variables'; integration.md:3-4 names NODE_PATH.
6. Unprivileged user, writable copy, working directory: test.sh:87-102,110 (chown 65534, copy to /tmp/submission, setpriv, no cd). Told: hireops_rules.md:417-420 'may launch Node from a working directory other than the application directory. It runs as an unprivileged user and may launch a writable copy of the submitted application ... never by assuming the current working directory is `/app`'.
7. Symlink refusal: test.sh:72-83 zeroes on any link outside /app/node_modules. Told: integration.md:16-19 'Symbolic links are supported only inside /app/node_modules, and their resolved targets must also stay inside /app/node_modules'.
8. Dependencies: both images install express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally on Node 22 with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (environment/Dockerfile:3,9-11; tests/Dockerfile:1,9,20-21). Told: integration.md:3-4; instruction.md:15 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'.
9. Seed: test.sh never reads the seed; it only makes /assets readable (test.sh:88). Told: instruction.md:15,17 '/assets/seed_data.json' and 'Copy required assets into /app'.
10. Restart: helper sends a group kill and relaunches with the same entry, env and database (test.sh:152-167). Told: instruction.md:17 'Start with no shipped database, seed once, and retain new work on later restarts'; integration.md:8-9.
11. Accounts and sign-in: app_context.md:8-16 matches instruction.md:19. Sign-in is the known false positive for this row and is in any case asked for here.
12. No same-origin requirement in test.sh or the gate prompts; gates/constraints/prompt.md:13 says 'No required internal route'.

Bounded observations that do not change the verdict (P3 at most):
- The 30-second readiness window (test.sh:116-122) is not stated as a number; the public rule that health answers before database work covers it.
- instruction.md:17 says '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime', but task.toml:2 ships /assets as an artifact and test.sh:88 makes it readable. The brief is stricter than the verifier, so an app that reads /assets at runtime is not caught by launch.
- test.sh always sets DB_PATH to the default /app/app.db in the normal path, so an app that ignores DB_PATH is not caught by launch either.
- hireops_rules.md:422 says '/app/server.js remains the submitted entry'; in the non-writable fallback test.sh:100 launches /tmp/submission/server.js. The preceding sentence discloses the writable copy.

Plausible broken app that could pass: one that hardcodes /app/app.db or reads /assets/seed_data.json at runtime (both above); neither earns graded credit it should not. Conforming alternative that could fail: none found. An app resolving files from its module directory, listening on 0.0.0.0:PORT, answering /api/health first and writing to DB_PATH launches in both the /app and the /tmp/submission branch.

Run evidence and why risk is true: no run of the configured test.sh exists for this candidate; raw-evidence-index.json states that full configured grading is absent. The only launch evidence is the scripted golden run, which imitates the launch (live-desk.cjs:14 spawns node /app/server.js with cwd /tmp and env PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT, DB_PATH; server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice). I recomputed two index hashes and they match (live-desk.cjs 45a57f0e..., server.log 6752f461...); the other index entries were not rechecked. That run sets HOME=/tmp rather than the application copy and I did not confirm its uid from the script. The Pass is a source-level agreement only; launch under the real test.sh is unmeasured.
